question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "departure".
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. **Advent**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"departure"** means the act of leaving or going away from a place. (प्रस्थान)
 
 
• **Example:** His departure from the company was sudden and unexpected.
 
 
• **"Advent"** refers to the arrival or coming of something, especially something important or awaited. (आगमन)
 
 
• **Example:** The advent of new technology has transformed modern communication.
